summary: Extract Git and ticket lifecycle subprojects

delivery.outcome: Git and ticket lifecycle are independently documented, machine-constrained modules, including a safe autonomous seed-baseline transaction for new repositories
nonGoals: Do not push directly to the default branch or reconfigure the existing remote
Do not merge a pull request, tag or publish a release
Do not weaken trusted exact-head review or target governance validation
Do not implement a general shell or arbitrary Git command executor
Do not modify the user's primary dirty new-project worktree

architecture.decision: Keep enforceable compatibility rules in POLICY and CONTRIBUTING while extracting detailed Git and ticket state machines into versioned subprojects with closed JSON Schema and request-only GBNF contracts
interfaceChanges: A new repository request in explicit autonomous mode may authorize one local governance seed-baseline commit under closed preconditions
Lifecycle mutations can be requested only through typed request ASTs resolved by a trusted controller
dataChanges: Introduce wellmanifest.git-lifecycle/v1 and wellmanifest.ticket-lifecycle/v1 document families
architecture.rollback: Remove the subprojects and revert the two top-level projections; no remote or publication side effect is part of this ticket
